quest.title: Transplanted From "Yesterday" to "Tomorrow"
quest.description: The "home" Nastya keeps speaking of is right inside that assembly hall looming in the distance...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...There is a part of my body right here. I can sense it more and more strongly now.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: It's... in the direction of that building over there. No, to be more precise, it's behind that building.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Yes, over there... Do you see it? That's "home" for everyone in town.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean that huge house over there? That's where everyone lives together?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: That huge house is our assembly hall. That's where everyone's hearts, everyone's leaves, and everyone's love are, all in one place. That's why it's home for everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: And a house is just a house. You don't get it, do you, Paimonka? "A house is merely a place to live, while a home is where the heart truly resides."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: My, my, how clever of you, Nastya-ka. So tell us, what does "reside" mean?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Um... well... "reside"... it's like "decide," you know? So home is the place where you can listen to your heart and choose whatever you want?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound quite right... but it does kind of make sense too...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Heh heh, but of course! Doctor Moreau also said that out of all the children here, I'm the smartest and most like him...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: It's all the fault of those horrid Volkodlak! If they hadn't taken me away... I should have my beautiful leaves by now. I should be able to understand the land and the trees by now...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Can you imagine how cool it is to understand what they're saying? And once you're family, you can grow branches too... You two aren't Badbugs. I believe you can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... imagine tree branches growing out of Paimon's head... That actually sounds kinda cool, doesn't it...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then we'll get an even more special Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Special...? But it's not good to be special...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Doctor Moreau said we'll stop fighting and competing once we're all the same. When that happens, everyone will get along perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But it's impossible for everyone to turn into exactly the same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{M#He's}{F#She's} right, you know! Even if you all turn into trees... some would be tall, some would be short, some would have green leaves while others are more yellow...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...You do sound a little more right than the Doctor... And it's true. Sometimes I'd look at my leaves and my friends' leaves to see whose are prettier...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...But once I get all my leaves, I won't have to eat anymore. Then, I can play Catch the Bug with my friends in the woods all day long!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W-W-W-What!? What do you mean, you don't eat!? No way! A-Anyway, branches growing out of Paimon's head would look really weird on someone who flies, okay!? Let's just forget about it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would rather have a belly full of food than be special any day...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: You seem to have gotten the wrong idea, Paimonka? What I meant was that we won't be afraid of going hungry. But if you really want something yummy, that's totally fine too.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: And there are so many other cool things about growing branches! Like... your body won't even hurt if you fall down super hard, because you'll be way bigger and stronger!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I know maybe you don't believe me right now. But once you see my family, you'll know what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... it does sound pretty cool to grow branches and stuff... But anyway! Let's get to town first! Then we'll find out if what Nastya's saying is true!

choices.text: Let's go find out for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right... This is where all our new friends used to get off... All we gotta do now is keep walking that way...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I know the way now. We gotta to walk through the station first.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Not many people know how to get around here because the Doctor said nobody's allowed to come to the station... But I do!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I was here once before when I was playing Catch the Bug... The Doctor was bringing some new friends to town right then, and when he saw me, he gave me a ride back too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's weird. Why would he forbid everyone from coming here...? There doesn't seem to be anything special about this place...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Oh, the Doctor said that's to keep everyone safe. Because we never know if any of our new friends are actually Badbugs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: New friends can be "Badbugs"...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Or does he mean that not all newcomers are good people, and some of them could possibly be Badbugs?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Um... I only know the Doctor said that it takes only one Badbug to ruin a whole forest. That's why we have to get rid of all of them!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: So, once Doctor Birdie catches all the Badbugs, we can all have a warm home full of love together...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I always win whenever I play Catch the Bug. Doctor Moreau even says that at this rate, I'll become a real Doctor Birdie soon, and catch all the Badbugs!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds a little... unusual...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And it sounds a little dangerous, too. Why would the Doctor ask a kid to do something like this...?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Oh? You don't have to worry about me! Zala will help me too. Not only does she protect all of us, she can tell right away if somebody is a Badbug! She's so cool.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Actually, Zala is the real Doctor Birdie... No, no, no, with those huge wings of hers, Zala is the Big Doctor Bird!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... "Bird"... Paimon's heard something about that before... Something about a strange giant bird in this town...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I don't know who you heard that from, Paimonka... But they must be talking about Zala!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: We'll see her once we're in town. And if she's in a good mood, you might even get to touch her beautiful leaf-feathers!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...You do have to be careful, though, because Zala can get grumpy very easily. She's only good when the Doctor is around.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Especially you, Paimonka, you have to be extra careful. You're so small and light like a leaf, Zala might just blow you far, far away if she flaps her wings!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't you worry about that! {NICKNAME} will hold on to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... now that we're talking about it, Paimon really wants to see this Zala bird for herself now!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Then let's get going! I don't really know where she is in town right now... But we'll definitely find her if we go looking for her!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Huh... Looks like there isn't a way through here either. We'll have to pass through the station then...

talks.objective: Pass through the station with Nastya

dialogues.speaker: Aunt LePuy
dialogues.text: AH! UGFFFF... Go... Burn!!!

dialogues.speaker: Aunt LePuy
dialogues.text: One... one... more... time... Become... new...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Looks like communicating with her is off the table...)

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: This is where we usually play Catch the Bug. But nobody seems to be around today... So I'll just play with you instead.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: But... since the two of you helped me, you're definitely not the Badbug.

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: I'll be the Badbug then. You two can play as Doctor Birdie. It's two against one, I'm going really easy on you!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: The rules are simple: catch me, and you win.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do we have to play right now?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Yes. The Doctor said it's super important that we follow every single step of the ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't have to go easy on me, because I'm going to win either way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay.. But since Paimon can fly, she'll be a really good Doctor Birdie, that's for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But what if we can't find you?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Then we'll meet at the <color=#00E1FFFF>town entrance</color>... Are you two ready? Let's begin!!!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This Doctor Birdie is in position.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And this Doctor Birdie is in position too!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Okay. Now relax, close your eyes, and count down from 60... Once you get to zero, you can start looking for the Badbug!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: 60, 59, 58... You count down silently in your head, as you get ready to "Catch the Bug."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! {NICKNAME}! Open your eyes! She's almost gone!!!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't believe you'd cheat like that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You gotta play fair, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? No, no, this isn't the time to argue about something like this! Paimon was just in the middle of her, uh... "tactical glimpse" where she realized that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She can go wherever she wants, but everywhere we go, we'll just keep running into dead ends! Come on, if we don't follow her now, we might get stuck here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And, and — it's not like we know the way to the town entrance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we'd better catch up with her now while we still can!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nastyaaa! Oof! Finally...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Huh? Wow, you're a really good Doctor Birdie! You caught me before I even got to hide...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, we've been running after you! This game of "Catch the Bug" is on pause for now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Too bad we didn't finish it this time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But we'll do it next time for sure! That's because you can go everywhere, Nastya, but {NICKNAME} and Paimon can't.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've found a serious loophole in the game rules...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} is right... You can go everywhere, Nastya, but the two of us can't!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So if we had waited for you to hide before coming to look for you, we might've ended up getting lost in the woods!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh heh, it’s all thanks to Paimon's incredible deductive and strategic skills that we're all here together now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wow! The Incredible Paimonka, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Wow! The Incredible Paimonka!!!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: ...Alright, we'll play again next time then! When I get home, I'll get everyone together for a game of Catch the Bug! It's gonna be so much more fun!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: The grown-ups over there just told me where I can find everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you were talking to them? They... can speak!?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? They are family! Of course I can talk to them...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Aunt LePuy. They aren't Badbugs. They are good people who brought me home... Yeah, I'll make sure they grow beautiful leaves too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Seriously? All these giant Leshy are Nastya's "family"??? Well... she does have branches growing right out of her head... But aside from the tree stuff... she looks just like any other kid!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Wait, what if her entire family turns out to be Leshy!? Does that mean we're gonna have to follow her all the way inside?! And why is Paimon getting nervous just thinking about it!?!!!!!!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (We still need to go in there to look for Goggles' body part...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Since we promised to take her home anyway...)

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: #...{M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, Paimonka, are you still taking me home? The grown-ups are awfully busy, as always...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't think it's a good idea to let her go home all by herself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And besides — we haven't even seen that "Zala" Nastya keeps talking about yet! Wouldn't it be a real pity if we walked away now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do it. Just to make sure that Nastya gets home safe and sound...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do it. Just to make sure that we see Zala with our own eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll come with you and take you back to your family. The two of us always get the job done!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Thank you so much... You two really are awesome! Almost as awesome as my idol Furiosa...

dialogues.speaker: Aunt LePuy
dialogues.text: ...Go... Busy...

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Alright, Aunt LePuy. I won't bother you anymore. I'm off then!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: #The grown-ups are too busy for me... {M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, Paimonka, let's keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's keep going then! But hold on, what are they doing?

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: Oh? They're burning the Badbugs! The Badbugs among the new friends, and the old friends who have turned into Badbugs too... They all have to be burned up!

dialogues.speaker: Nastya
dialogues.text: "Once reduced to ash, the Badbugs will nourish the soil, while it is from that same earth that new family will grow." That's how the bad can become good all over again!
